results.test: Fresh visits default to original dark theme even with a light OS preference
Light theme changes all 31 slides, text, tables and page while preserving images
Theme preference survives reload and presentation changes it without moving slides
Mouse left click advances and right click returns on slide content
Selected text, double clicks and context menus never interrupt slide clicks
Mouse wheel navigates one slide per gesture and ignores horizontal scrolling
Mouse navigation clamps first/last slides and controls avoid double navigation
F11 and Escape exit presentation and release fullscreen
Light mobile reading retains all slides and has no horizontal overflow
Saved light theme and mouse presentation work after an offline reload
Theme and mouse controls produce no console or JavaScript errors
